name: Huddled Group Plc
summary: Huddled Group Plc is a UK-based e-commerce retail group specialising in surplus goods. It operates a portfolio of brands including Discount Dragon (groceries), Nutricircle (wellness products), and Boop Beauty (cosmetics). The company was formerly known as Let's Explore Group PLC and changed its name to Huddled Group Plc in October 2023.
